title: 比较与用量：比较级、too much / many、enough
instructions: 先理解本课新结构，再独立作答。提交后查看原句、正确表达和原因。
passage:
本课用做饭的场景比较选择，并说明数量是否合适。上一课的物品归属继续用于描述厨房物品。

1. 常见短形容词比较级加 -er：fresh → fresher；bright → brighter。This apple is fresher than that one. big → bigger（双写末尾辅音）；形容词以 y 结尾时常变 y 为 i：easy → easier。

2. 较长形容词常用 more + 形容词：This recipe is more difficult than that one. 不写 more easier。比较对象后用 than，不是 then。good 的比较级是不规则的 better：This recipe is better for our group.

3. 从三个或更多对象中比较最高程度，常用 the + 最高级：This is the brightest room in the apartment. This is the easiest recipe of the three. 比较级与最高级需看语境，不要只靠一个关键词判断。

4. 数量太多：too many + 复数可数名词（too many eggs）；too much + 不可数名词（too much rice）。表示有一些用 a few + 可数复数（a few apples）或 a little + 不可数（a little tea）。

5. enough 放在名词前：enough food；放在形容词后：big enough。This bowl is big enough for the salad. There is enough rice for three people. too + 形容词表示超出合适程度：The coffee is too hot to drink.

6. 选择与偏好：I prefer tea to coffee. Would you like some tea? 提供饮品时可用 some，期待对方接受；不是所有问句都必须用 any。

questions.prompt: This apple is ____ than that one. It was picked this morning.
questions.evidence: This apple is fresher than that one.
questions.explanation: 比较两个苹果的新鲜程度，fresh 变 fresher。

questions.prompt: This bowl is ____ than the small one.
questions.explanation: big 的比较级双写 g 再加 er。

questions.prompt: This recipe has fewer steps. It is ____ than the other one.
questions.explanation: easy 变 y 为 i 再加 er；不能写 more easier。

questions.prompt: This recipe is ____ difficult than the first one.
questions.evidence: This recipe is more difficult than that one.
questions.explanation: difficult 是较长形容词，比较级使用 more difficult。

questions.prompt: This kitchen is brighter ____ that kitchen.
questions.evidence: This apple is fresher than that one.
questions.explanation: 比较对象用 than；then 表示然后。

questions.prompt: This is the ____ room in the apartment. No other room gets as much light.
questions.evidence: This is the brightest room in the apartment.
questions.explanation: 从整套公寓房间中比较最高程度，使用 the brightest。

questions.prompt: Of these three recipes, this is the ____.
questions.evidence: This is the easiest recipe of the three.
questions.explanation: 三个食谱比较最容易，用最高级 easiest。

questions.prompt: This recipe is ____ for our group than the old one.
questions.evidence: This recipe is better for our group.
questions.explanation: good 的比较级为 better，不是 gooder。

questions.prompt: We bought too ____ eggs for two people.
questions.explanation: eggs 是复数可数名词，too many 表示太多。

questions.prompt: There is too ____ rice in this bowl.
questions.explanation: rice 是不可数名词，使用 too much。

questions.prompt: We need a ____ apples for the pie.
questions.explanation: apples 为可数复数，a few 表一些；a little 用于不可数名词。

questions.prompt: Please add a ____ tea to the cup.
questions.explanation: tea 此处指茶水，为不可数，使用 a little。

questions.evidence: This bowl is big enough for the salad.
questions.explanation: enough 放在形容词 big 后；在名词前时可说 enough food。
prefer A to B 是偏好比较搭配，不能套用形容词比较级的 than。
